jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or in a similar analytical role Strong programming skills in Python, including reusable libraries and experience with pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn and/or PyTorch/TensorFlow Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Oracle)
